title: 0. Executive Thesis, Dual Verdict & Opportunity Matrix (Nov 2026 Refresh)

epigraph.quote: Great engineering earns a place on the watchlist; only an asymmetric entry price earns fresh capital.
epigraph.author: Institutional Underwriting Desk

web_blocks.html: SEDEMAC Mechatronics Ltd (NSE: SEDEMAC) is an IIT Bombay-incubated (2007) electronics leader [2]. It builds patented sensorless ISG, EFI ECUs, EV motor controllers (ISAAC), and genset AMF controllers (~75% India share) [7, 8, 9]. Our price-blind audit (Chapters 1–6) retains a Compounder Pass business-quality grade with active forensic monitoring. Q2 FY27 hit a record 1.45M ECUs (+37.5% YoY), and scooter controllers passed 5 million [31, 32]. A European 2W/3W OEM awarded an ISG contract (SoP H1 FY28), and India Ratings upgraded debt to IND A/Stable [32, 34]. Yet Pass 1 forensics exposed -₹20.38 Cr H1 operating cash flow, a 7.4x jump in short-term debt to ₹153.19 Cr (₹352 Cr total incl. leases) after a 100% OFS IPO [26, 33], an H1 effective tax-rate drop to 19%–22% flattering headline PAT [1, 39], a -21.8% Industrial slump (Mobility hit 91.1%), and Lucas-TVS EV rivalry [30, 31].

In Pass 2 (Chapters 7–9), we test this franchise against two labeled cutoffs. The verified 2026-11-23 NSE ledger close is ₹3,118.40. The 2026-11-25 live TradingView close is ₹3,187.50 (+2.22% 1D; ₹13,831.59 Cr TV / ₹14,095 Cr Screener market cap) [1, 22]. Shares trade at 109.0x Screener P/E and 27.0x P/B. Reconciling the full FY28E P&L bridge (₹1,950 Cr sales, 19.5% OPM, ₹117.00 Cr D&A, ₹28.16 Cr finance costs, 25.17%–30.0% normalized tax, and 4.518 Cr ESOP-diluted shares) yields ₹37.20–₹39.77 diluted EPS. At a peer-aligned 55.3x multiple (matching Bosch India at 54.7x), Base fair value is ₹2,200.00 (-31.0% vs live; Red Team 30%-tax stress ₹2,045.88). Probability-weighted expected value is ₹2,305.00 (-27.7%). Thus, new capital is REJECTED (zero new-capital allocation on valuation and cash-flow grounds).

Our Zerodha holding already executed the prior 100-share trim (200 to 100 shares, banking ₹1,06,420.08). Zerodha now holds 100 shares at ₹2,025.49 average cost (₹2,02,549.12). Value is ₹3,11,840.00 on the 2026-11-23 ledger (+53.96%; 7.31% weight, #1 slot) and ₹3,18,750.00 on live TradingView (+57.37%). While SEDEMAC coils in a 7.0% Bollinger-bandwidth Stage 2 volatility squeeze above its 10-week EMA (₹3,123.31) and 50-day SMA (₹3,171.07), negative expected value (-27.7%), 8 distribution days, -16.6% 28-day relative strength, and expiring 60-day PE block lock-ins (~44–49 lakh prior block = ~42–46x daily volume) create acute gap-through risk [22, 28]. We tighten our overweight trim to 50 shares (50% of the stake; ~₹1,59,375 live TV), cutting weight to ~3.66% on 50 core shares behind an upward-ratcheted ₹2,789.41 stop (up from ₹2,696.82; secondary 25-share trim at ₹3,450.00).

book_paragraphs: Welcome to our November 2026 refreshed institutional monograph on SEDEMAC Mechatronics Ltd. Before we step into the ten chapters together, let me lay out the exact architecture of our updated decision—because this refresh demonstrates why disciplined investors re-underwrite winners with fresh eyes instead of coasting on an old thesis.

In Pass 1, working strictly price-blind through Chapters 1 to 6, we audited every new filing, concall transcript remark, and competitive signal since our November 13 baseline. The operational engine remains genuinely impressive: SEDEMAC shipped a record 1,452,867 control-intensive ECUs in Q2 FY27 (+37.5% YoY), surpassed 5 million cumulative scooter motor controllers in October 2026, won a landmark European 2W/3W OEM contract for ISG ECU and magneto kits starting in H1 FY28, and earned an India Ratings upgrade to IND A/Stable. Accordingly, the business retains our **Compounder Pass** business-quality grade with active forensic monitoring.

Yet our forensic blind-spot audit also uncovered five material risks that were hidden beneath headline numbers two weeks ago. First, SEDEMAC's March 2026 IPO (₹1,087.45 Cr) was a 100% Offer for Sale that injected zero fresh equity capital into the company. Second, H1 FY27 Operating Cash Flow flipped negative to -₹20.38 Cr (versus +₹120.73 Cr in H1 FY26) on surging receivables (₹212.16 Cr) and inventory (₹287.81 Cr), driving a 7.4x jump in short-term financial borrowings to ₹153.19 Cr within ₹352 Cr of aggregated borrowings (including ₹106.47 Cr of Ind AS 116 lease liabilities). Third, quarterly effective tax rates dropped from 43% and 33% in Q1/Q2 FY26 to 19% and 22% in Q1/Q2 FY27 on the shift to India's new tax regime, flattering Q2 PAT growth (+30.0% YoY) over underlying Q2 PBT growth (+13.3% YoY). Fourth, Industrial genset sales contracted -21.8% YoY in H1 FY27 (Q2 segment profit -33.9%), pushing Mobility concentration from 86.2% to 91.1% and deepening reliance on TVS Motor. Fifth, November 2026 industry mapping confirmed direct domestic 2W/3W low-voltage EV controller competition from TVS-group affiliate Lucas-TVS, Sterling Tools, Minda Corp, and Uno Minda—alongside a November 18 report flagging expiring 60-day PE block-deal lock-ins for A91, Xponentia, and HDFC Life.

In Pass 2, we tested these refreshed fundamentals against two explicitly labeled market cutoffs: the verified **2026-11-23 NSE ledger close of ₹3,118.40** and the **2026-11-25 live TradingView snapshot close of ₹3,187.50** (Market Cap ₹13,831.59 Cr TV / ₹14,095 Cr Screener). At 109.0x Screener trailing P/E and 27.0x P/B, the market already prices in ~28–30% annual revenue compounding for a full decade. Walking cleanly through the full FY28E P&L bridge—₹1,950 Cr sales at 19.5% OPM (₹380.25 Cr EBITDA), less ₹117.00 Cr depreciation (6.0% of sales on doubled ₹518 Cr fixed assets), less ₹28.16 Cr finance costs (8.0% on ₹352 Cr debt and leases), plus ₹5.00 Cr other income, and 25.17%–30.0% normalized tax—yields ₹168.06 Cr to ₹179.66 Cr of PAT across 4.518 Cr ESOP-diluted shares, or **₹37.20 to ₹39.77** diluted EPS. Applying a peer-aligned **55.3x** multiple (matching Bosch India at 54.7x) produces a Base fair value of **₹2,200.00** (-31.0% vs live; Red Team 30%-tax stress **₹2,045.88** at 55x × ₹37.20). With Bull at ₹3,350.00 (+5.1%) and Bear at ₹1,470.00 (-53.9%), probability-weighted expected value is **₹2,305.00 (-27.7%)**. Therefore, **new capital remains REJECTED** (zero new-capital budget on valuation and cash-flow grounds).

For our existing Zerodha position, the portfolio already executed the prior 100-share rebalance (200 to 100 shares, realizing ₹1,06,420.08 in profit). Zerodha still holds **100 shares** at ₹2,025.49 average cost (₹2,02,549.12), worth ₹3,11,840.00 on the 2026-11-23 ledger (+53.96%; **7.31% weight**, still our #1 equity position) and ₹3,18,750.00 on the 2026-11-25 live TV close (+57.37%). Given the -27.7% negative expected value, 8 distribution days, -16.6% 28-day relative strength, and acute gap-through risk from the expiring 60-day PE block-deal lock-in (the prior ~44–49 lakh share block equals ~42–46 days of normal volume), retaining 70% of the position is too loose. We tighten our **Trim Overweight** action to **50 shares** (half the stake; ~₹1,59,375 live TV, redeploying 60% to Cash and 40% to verified Stage 2 shortlist name COFORGE) to lower single-stock weight to **~3.66%**, and retain **50 core house-money shares** behind our upward-ratcheted hard stop at **₹2,789.41** (up +₹92.59 from ₹2,696.82) with a secondary 25-share trim at ₹3,450.00.

book_callouts.title: NARRATOR'S REFLECTION
book_callouts.text: When a winner sits at +57.4% as your #1 equity position (7.31% weight) at 109x trailing P/E and -27.7% expected value—just as H1 operating cash flow flips negative and pre-IPO PE funds exit a 60-day lock-in equal to 42–46 days of volume—trimming half the stake (50 shares) into house-money status (~3.66% weight) and ratcheting your stop upward to ₹2,789.41 is textbook institutional risk management.

book_subsections.title: What Changed in This November 2026 Refresh & How to Read the Monograph
paragraphs: Chapters 1 through 6 were updated strictly price-blind before looking at a single ticker quote, patching baseline chapters with newly verified filings, verbatim earnings-call excerpts, and blind-spot checks. Chapter 1 now incorporates the 100% Offer-for-Sale IPO structure (zero fresh cash to SEDEMAC), the September 24 PE block sales (A91, Xponentia, HDFC Life) and November 18 lock-in expiry overhang, and ~2.2% ESOP 2025 dilution (including NSE Circular CML77614 on November 20, 2026). Chapter 2 updates the segment mix to reflect H1 FY27's stark divergence: Mobility surging >52% YoY to 91.1% of sales while Industrial gensets contracted -21.8% YoY.

Chapter 3 preserves our deterministic ₹100 FY26 revenue-to-FCF waterfall and B2B OEM co-development unit economics. Chapter 4 expands the competitive matrix beyond global Tier-1s (Bosch, Denso, Continental) to include scaled domestic 2W/3W low-voltage EV controller rivals—specifically TVS-group affiliate Lucas-TVS, Sterling Tools, Minda Corporation, Kinetic Communications, Uno Minda, and Varroc Engineering—under the extended PM E-DRIVE localisation window through March 31, 2028, alongside primary SEC citations for our Sensata Technologies structural parallel. Chapter 5 updates our six operational KPIs with record 1.45M Q2 ECUs (+37.5% YoY), >5M cumulative scooter controllers, the European 2W/3W OEM contract win, India Ratings IND A/Stable upgrade, and verbatim November 3, 2026 earnings-call commentary from MD Prof. Shashikanth Suryanarayanan and JMD Amit Dixit.

Chapter 6 delivers our sharpest forensic upgrade: decomposing Screener's ₹352 Cr aggregated borrowings into ₹245.64 Cr of financial debt (with short-term borrowings jumping 7.4x from ₹20.75 Cr to ₹153.19 Cr) plus ₹106.47 Cr of Ind AS 116 lease liabilities (matched by ₹144.16 Cr of Right-of-Use assets), flagging the swing to -₹20.38 Cr H1 FY27 Operating Cash Flow, and disclosing the drop in quarterly effective tax rates from 43%/33% (Q1/Q2 FY26) to 19%/22% (Q1/Q2 FY27).

Finally, Chapters 7, 8, and 9 bring valuation, technicals, and our 100-share Zerodha position together with full session-date transparency (explicitly separating 2026-11-23 NSE ledger closes from 2026-11-25 live TradingView snapshots) and a fully reconciled FY28E EBITDA-to-PAT bridge with ESOP dilution and peer-aligned 55x valuation multiples. Every peer benchmark (Uno Minda, Bosch Ltd, Sona BLW, KPIT Technologies), every probability-weighted target, our upward-only stop-loss ratchet (₹2,696.82 to ₹2,789.41), our tightened 50-share trim, and our 100%-reconciled capital redeployment plan (60% Cash, 40% verified Stage 2 shortlist name COFORGE, bypassing Stage 3 MANORAMA) trace cleanly back to primary session data. Let us begin in Chapter 1.
